description: Common free time across participants: intersect availability windows, report who blocks — Intersects up to 20 participants' free windows (up to 200 each, half-open RFC 3339 intervals with Z or offsets, so mixed time zones are fine) into the common slots at least minMinutes long, optionally clipped to a search window; when nothing fits, names the participants whose removal would create a slot. name: slot-intersect
